scripts.preinstall: node -e "try { const ua = process.env.npm_config_user_agent || process.env.NPM_CONFIG_USER_AGENT || ''; const execPath = process.env.npm_execpath || process.env.NPM_NODE_EXEC_PATH || ''; if (ua && !ua.includes('pnpm')) { console.error('Use pnpm instead'); process.exit(1); } else if (!ua && execPath && !/pnpm/i.test(execPath)) { console.error('Use pnpm instead'); process.exit(1); } } catch (e) {}"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
